# Check: front page and sign-in screens (ticker.allomos.com)

1. In a private window, open https://ticker.allomos.com: the front page matches the mock-up you approved (headline, sign-in button, "Try a search", example watchlist, three tiles), in light and dark, on a computer and on your phone.
2. "Try a search" puts the cursor in the search box; "Sign in to start your lists" opens the sign-in card with the logo.
3. Ask for a sign-in link: the "Check your email" card shows the code field and "Use a different email". Open the link: its page is the same card style.
4. Switch the language at the foot of the page: the front page's wording changes with it.
